iSoftwares.soft_memo:
Windows version of SPIM
You need compiled MIPS assembly code as input to PCSPIM.
To run the simulator and generate trace:
Each record in the trace file has the following format: [0x00400000] 0x8fa40000 lw $4, 0($29); 102: lw $a0, 0($sp) where the first field is the address of the instruction, the second field is its binary code, the third field is the assembly code, and the fourth field is the corresponding source assembly code
Compile C codes to MIPS assembly codes

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
You are encouraged to interact with other students to discuss course material, form study groups for the exams, help each other learn the details, and provide each other with assistance, encouragement, and moral support. However, all individual assignments (i.e., homeworks and exams) are to be performed on your own (i.e., copying off someone else is prohibited).

Encourage you to use the AI tools to obtain the reference solutions of any problems of your homework assignments. 

If your solutions are originated from the  AI tools, you should markup the differences between the  AI tools solutions and your submitted solutions as well as answer the following questions.

1.	Why did your instructor assign you this problem as a homework?
2.	Why did the  AI tools give you this solution to reply the problem that your instructor assigned?
3.	Does the  AI tools solution fulfill the education purpose of your instructor to assign this problem?

If you did NOT reply above three questions for each problem, you may get a zero point for that solution.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: For exam or on-site tests, the  AI tools or any other networking  communication is prohibited
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
As a FCU student, you’ve joined a community that upholds integrity in all of its academic endeavours, and you’ve made a personal commitment to studying with academic integrity. This means that, whenever you work on an assignment or submit an assessment, you do so honestly, fairly, respectfully and responsibly.
Understand that plagiarism, collusion and cheating bring serious consequences. Not only while you’re at FCU, but well beyond. Such misconduct could harm you personally and professionally for the rest of your life.

The Honor Code obligates you not only to abide by this policy, but also to report any violations that you become aware of. Violations of this policy will be brought to the International School of Honor Council. For more information on the Honor Code, see Academic Integrity  web page.
 
https://www.monash.edu/students/study-support/academic-integrity
